Name: PlumAdorable's Female Bachelor Portraits
Author: PlumAdorable
Description:
[center][size=3]ABANDONED
Sorry, guys! I don’t have any plans to keep up with this mod.

Portraits for the female bachelors, in a style similar to that of the original game[/size][size=4].[/size][/center][center]﻿[/center][center]﻿[/center]Invatorzen's amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Dialogue Changes mod[/url] changes all six bachelors -- Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane -- into bachelorettes -- Alex, Elena, Harriet, Sam, Sabrina, and Shane -- for those of us who just ain't about men.

Invatorzen's mod manages the name and pronoun changes, the sprites, and comes with its own female portraits. [b]PlumAdorable's Female Bachelor Portraits[/b] offers an alternative to those portraits, but does not alter anything else from Inatorzen's original mod.

PlumAdorable's female bachelor portraits remain true both to the original art style of Stardew Valley as well as the original spirit of the characters.

Includes both standard and Ginger Island portraits.


[center][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/center][list=1]
[/list][center]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes with SVE Support (Content Patcher)[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/center]

[b]Instructions[/b]
- Download this mod.
- Extract the contents of this mod into your [i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits[/i] folder. Once done, the file path should look like: [i]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/PlumAdorable's Female Bachelor Portraits/[png files here][/i].
- Open Stardew Valley and speak to any NPC. Press P to cycle through the portrait mods you have installed until you reach PlumAdorable's Female Bachelor Portraits.

[size=2]This selection will stick, and the game will use these portraits until you select others.[/size]
